$comment: The workflow vocabulary: everything a pipeline, a stage action, a cycle's
application kinds and a form's cross-field rules may be configured with.
Pipelines, stages, status flags, actions and their inputs are data, authored
by whoever holds the `pipeline` permissions. What that data may SAY is fixed
here, in code, because each entry below is backed by code that carries it
out: an effect by its handler, a rule by its evaluators, a parameter kind by
its validator and its editor control. A configuration can only combine these;
it cannot invent one, so nothing configured can ask for behaviour that does

and is what the Worker imports, for the same reason `auth/catalog.json` has

inputFieldTypes.description: A short line of text, such as a reference number.
A paragraph, such as a note to the next stage. Never copied into the activity history.
An amount of money, entered in rupees and kept in paise.
One of a fixed list of options, such as a bank.
Any of a fixed list of options.
Text shown to the officer, with no answer.

conditionSources.description: An answer the applicant gave on the submitted form.
Whether the application currently holds a status flag.
A value an earlier action recorded on the application.
What the officer entered into this action's own inputs.

paramKinds.description: A stage of the same pipeline.
A status flag the pipeline declares.
One of the action's own input fields.
A question on the form of any cycle that pins the pipeline; checked when the cycle opens.
A recorded value the pipeline declares.
For each option of a choice input, the stage it sends the application to.
Fixed text written by the author, such as a message to the applicant.
A whole number of zero or more.
A fixed amount of money, in paise.
A kind of application the cycle declares.

formRules.description: At least one of these yes-or-no questions must be answered yes — for example, a grant, a loan, or both.
These answers must all differ — for example, a first and a second choice of bank.
These amounts together may not exceed a fixed limit.
The first answer may not exceed the second — for example, a loan asked for may not exceed the project's cost.

eligibilityRules.description: The enterprise has an earlier application that holds a status flag, held for at least a number of months.

params.name: flag
params.description: The flag the earlier application must hold.

params.name: pipelineKey
params.description: Only earlier applications worked in this pipeline.

params.name: minMonthsSinceFlag
params.description: How long ago, at least, the flag must have been added.

eligibilityRules.description: An earlier application of the enterprise recorded a value of at least an amount.

params.name: value
params.description: The recorded value to read.

params.name: amountPaise
params.description: The least it must be.

eligibilityRules.description: The enterprise has no unfinished application of a kind — a draft, or one still being worked.

params.name: kind
params.description: The kind that must have no open application.

eligibilityRules.description: The enterprise has made fewer than a number of applications of a kind, across every cycle.

params.name: kind
params.description: The kind to count.

params.name: max
params.description: How many are allowed in all.

eligibilityRules.description: The enterprise was established at least a number of months ago.

params.name: months
params.description: The least age, in whole months.

effects.description: Adds a status flag. A flag that ends the pipeline is added by COMPLETE_PIPELINE or CLOSE_APPLICATION instead.

params.name: flag
params.description: The flag to add.

params.name: flag
params.description: The flag to remove.

effects.description: Keeps what the officer entered as a named value on the application, such as the approved grant.

params.name: input
params.description: The input whose value is kept.

params.name: target
params.description: The name it is kept under.

params.name: atMostAnswer
params.description: It may not exceed the applicant's answer to this question.

params.name: atMostCycleCeiling
params.description: It may not exceed the cycle's funding ceiling.

effects.description: Asks the applicant to correct the form stages the officer names. When they resubmit, the application returns to this stage.

params.name: flag
params.description: The flag held while the applicant corrects it; it must allow revision-scoped editing.

effects.description: Tells the applicant, on their timeline and by email when asked to.

params.name: message
params.description: What the applicant reads.

params.name: email
params.description: Also send it by email.

effects.description: Keeps what the officer wrote as a staff-only note on the application.

params.name: input
params.description: The long-text input holding the note.

effects.description: Sends the application to another stage.

params.name: target
params.description: The stage it goes to.

effects.description: Sends the application to the stage chosen by one of the action's inputs — for example, the bank.

params.name: input
params.description: The single-choice input that decides.

params.name: routes
params.description: Where each option sends it; every option must be routed.

effects.description: Sends the application back to the stage it actually came from.
Finishes the application's journey successfully, with a flag that ends the pipeline.

params.name: flag
params.description: The terminal flag it finishes with.

effects.description: Ends the application's journey without success, such as a rejection, with a flag that ends the pipeline.

params.name: flag
params.description: The terminal flag it closes with.
